data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 6.2m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013 GBP 3.5m).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1301 opened 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 79.107m (balance sheet comparative). The report discloses a net release on prior year claims of GBP 6.2m (stated as a release in the movement note), equivalent to a ~7.8% reduction of opening gross claims. No gross prior-year movement amount was disclosed in the technical movement note, so the reported net release has been used as the quantified PYD. The movement is described as favourable claims development; no specific prior-year catastrophe or large loss events are named as driving this movement.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 6.2m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013 GBP 3.5m).
